name: Will flushing my water heater improve water pressure or hot water temperature?

mainEntity.name: Will flushing my water heater improve water pressure or hot water temperature?

acceptedAnswer.text: While flushing a water heater primarily addresses sediment buildup to improve efficiency and extend lifespan, it can indirectly affect hot water temperature and, in some cases, pressure. If sediment has significantly insulated the heating element or burner, removing it can allow the unit to heat water more effectively, leading to hotter water. If sediment has partially blocked the hot water outlet, its removal could slightly improve hot water flow. However, severe pressure issues are more often related to main water lines or fixtures, not typically solved by flushing the water heater alone.
acceptedAnswer.description: Flushing primarily improves efficiency and hot water temperature by removing sediment. It's less likely to resolve major water pressure issues.
